what: Historical sensor-withholding replay of the saved NOAA-20 bridge test (Protocol P04, test G03)
not: Not a simulation of future burning and not independent ground-truth validation. S-NPP is the reference satellite, another instrument, not the truth on the ground.
area_scope: The frozen test covers Punjab only. Pakistan, Sindh and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa are reported, not tested; other areas have no result.
calibration_window: April 2018 to December 2025 (the bridge's training months; nothing fitted on 2026)
simulation: S-NPP is hidden from the replay's available inputs; the record continues on NOAA-20 times the saved bridge factors; the withheld S-NPP counts are then shown for comparison.
platform_status: S-NPP ended 2 Nov 2026, 15:40 UTC (NOAA NESDIS Update #4)
units: detections per UTC day in Punjab (day and night passes): fire pixels on satellite passes

saved.pass_mark: primary bridge only: WAPE <= 0.1 and every scored month with at least 300 S-NPP detections within 20% of observed
saved.matched_days_rule: neither satellite on either refreshed list, and each satellite has at least one row anywhere in Pakistan on its day pass and on its night pass that UTC day (every row, before the quality rule). 'Anywhere in Pakistan' means rows of the month's chosen stream (SP or NRT) that passed c08.ingest.parse_frame's data contract and fall inside a province polygon (any of the seven), counted before the quality rule and before the type screen
saved.bridge_rule: M1 (hz.fit(..., 'M1', src='NOAA20')) on Punjab's complete months of 2018-04 to 2025-12 (p01.DEPLOY_BRIDGE), refitted without the type screen for months with no type field; nothing refitted on 2026
